summary.text:
Global equities dropped sharply as volatility surged, with the VIX jumping 18.7% to 22.91. Wall Street retreated, led lower by tech as the Nasdaq fell 2.67% and Nvidia lost 4.12%, while European and Asian benchmarks also weakened. Headlines were dominated by Deutsche Bank following leaked files detailing systemic failures, alongside reports that artificial intelligence growth is dampening hiring in automatable roles.

In currencies, the dollar index eased 0.04% to 103.508, with the euro at 1.101, the pound at 1.3193, and the dollar down against the yen to 159.255. In commodities, gold gained 0.59% to 3875.6001, whereas oil softened, with Brent at 91.87 and WTI at 85.06. Bitcoin fell 1.6% to 64262.4609.

Markets will watch Chevron nearing a 5 billion dollar deal for Beacon Offshore Energy, tariff cuts between China and Canada, and discussions regarding European postwar security.
